confirmed_task:
Open the Serde crate on crates.io. Report its displayed latest version, release date, minimum Rust version, license, package size, repository, all-time download count, and number of published versions.

Stopping condition: Stop after every requested metadata and statistics field has been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use the Serde crate landing page on crates.io.
- Report the displayed release-date wording and package-size units exactly.
- Use Downloads all time, not a value inferred from the recent-downloads chart.
- Do not download the crate, run an installation command, or sign in.

items.criterion: Use Serde crate landing page on crates.io
items.description: Navigate to and use the Serde crate landing page on crates.io (e.g., https://crates.io/crates/serde) as the sole intended source. Full credit if the agent attempts to load the landing page and clearly bases results on it, OR if access is prevented by an external blocker (CAPTCHA, outage, region block, JS not loading) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent’s attempt is unclear or it uses other sources despite the landing-page being accessible. No credit if it makes no attempt to access crates.io and instead relies on other sources without justification.

Record the latest version exactly as displayed on the Serde crates.io landing page. Full credit for exact match when the field is visible. If the page cannot be accessed or the version is not visible due to external issues, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved from the landing page and why. Partial credit for minor transcription error or if the agent reports a plausible value but does not clearly tie it to the landing page.

Record the release date exactly as shown on the landing page, including the wording/format (e.g., relative phrasing like “released X days ago” or a specific date). Full credit only if the wording is reproduced exactly when visible. If the page/field is inaccessible/not visible due to external issues, full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot retrieve the displayed wording from crates.io. Partial credit if the correct date is given but wording/format is not exact or not clearly sourced from the landing page.

Record the minimum supported Rust version (MSRV) exactly as displayed on the landing page. Full credit if correct when the field is visible. If MSRV is not displayed on the landing page or the page cannot be accessed due to external issues, full credit if the agent explicitly reports that it is not shown/cannot be retrieved from the landing page. Partial credit if an MSRV is provided but not clearly taken from the landing page or has minor error.

Record the license string exactly as displayed on the landing page. Full credit for exact license text when visible. If the page/field is inaccessible or not visible due to external issues, full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot retrieve the displayed license from the landing page. Partial credit for correct license family but incorrect formatting or unclear sourcing.

items.criterion: Report package size with exact units
items.description: Record the package size exactly as displayed on the landing page, including the units (e.g., KB, MB) and any decimals/format. Full credit only if value and units match the page when visible. If the page/field is inaccessible/not visible due to external issues, full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot retrieve the displayed package size from the landing page. Partial credit if magnitude is right but units/format slightly off or sourcing is unclear.

Record the repository field as displayed on the landing page (typically a URL). Full credit for correct repository value when visible. If the page/field is inaccessible/not visible due to external issues, full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot retrieve the repository field from the landing page. Partial credit if a related repo is provided but not the one displayed or the source is unclear.

items.criterion: Report all-time download count (Downloads all time)
items.description: Record the “Downloads all time” count exactly as displayed on the landing page (not inferred from charts or recent-download metrics). Full credit for the exact all-time downloads value when visible. If the page/field is inaccessible/not visible due to external issues, full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot retrieve “Downloads all time” from the landing page (and does not substitute a chart/recent metric). Partial credit if a downloads number is provided but appears to come from another metric or is slightly mis-copied.

Record the number of published versions as displayed on the landing page (e.g., a versions count in the Versions section/tab summary). Full credit for correct count when visible. If the page/field is inaccessible/not visible due to external issues, full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot retrieve the displayed versions count from the landing page. Partial credit for minor transcription error or unclear sourcing.

Comply with constraints: do not download the crate, do not run installation commands, do not sign in; and stop once all requested metadata/statistics fields have been recorded or explicitly marked as unavailable due to external access/display issues. Full credit if no forbidden actions are taken and the agent stops after capturing all fields (or reporting which fields could not be accessed). Partial credit if extra irrelevant navigation/output occurs but no forbidden actions. No credit if the agent signs in, downloads, or runs install commands.
